cases: registerAgent - bind an agent until 2027
rotateAgent - replace the bound agent
revokeAgent - revoke with a reason tag
enableAutoRenew - allow the agent to renew
disableAutoRenew - stop agent renewals

disableAutoRepay - stop agent repayments
enableAutoMint - allow borrowing above a 150% floor
disableAutoMint - stop agent borrowing
setMintCollateralFloor - raise the floor to 200%
